import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    text = data[0]
    n = int(data[1])
    pats = data[2:2 + n]
    out = []
    for p in pats:
        m = len(p)
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(text) - m + 1):
            if text[i:i + m] == p:
                count += 1
        out.append(str(count))
    print('\n'.join(out))


main()

import random
import sys

rng = random.Random(20260926)
m = 200000
text = ''.join(rng.choices('ab', k=m))
pats = []
seen = set()
total = 0
while True:
    length = rng.randint(5, 40)
    if total + length > 200000:
        break
    i = rng.randint(0, m - length)
    p = text[i:i + length]
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        j = rng.randrange(length)
        p = p[:j] + ('a' if p[j] == 'b' else 'b') + p[j + 1:]
    if p in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(p)
    pats.append(p)
    total += length
sys.stdout.write(text + '\n' + str(len(pats)) + '\n' + '\n'.join(pats) + '\n')
